content.rationale: The version decision's content is one machine-readable token, and its claim is that every stamping surface takes that token from the node instead of keeping its own. Prose non-contradiction cannot tell one token value from another, so the check observes the artifacts: it reads the recorded token, requires it to equal the release value this layer sets (0.2.0), and requires each present stamping surface — the package manifest, and the lockfile when present — to carry the same token. The prerequisite is prose and the dependent is tool-checkable, the matrix's natural-to-code fidelity cell: the check pins the dependent to exactly the prerequisite's single-source claim, neither stricter nor looser.
